{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data_clean = data[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Stratify by customer segment and compute conversion rate and average revenue within each segment
# First, compute conversion rate by channel and segment
table = pd.crosstab(
    index=[data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']],
    columns='converted',
    values=data_clean['converted'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Compute average revenue by channel and segment
revenue_table = pd.crosstab(
    index=[data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']],
    columns='revenue',
    values=data_clean['revenue_clean'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Combine results
results = pd.concat([table, revenue_table], axis=1)
results = results.round(4)

# Display results
print("Conversion and revenue by channel and segment:")
print(results)

# Now compute the difference in conversion and revenue within each segment
# For conversion: difference in conversion rate between email and paid_search, within each segment
conversion_diff = results['converted'].groupby(level=1).diff().dropna()

# For revenue: difference in average revenue between email and paid_search, within each segment
revenue_diff = results['revenue'].groupby(level=1).diff().dropna()

# Display differences
print("\nDifference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(conversion_diff)

print("\nDifference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(revenue_diff)"}
